# Demodesk

> Demodesk is an AI Sales Agent platform built for B2B revenue teams. Four AI agents and a custom AI Agent Builder record conversations, update CRMs, coach reps, and rescue at-risk deals automatically so sales teams focus on selling.

Founded in 2018 in Munich, Germany. German company, EU-only data storage (Azure Frankfurt). 300+ companies, 20,000+ users, 98 languages. GDPR-native, ISO 27001:2022 certified. Customer data never used for AI training.

German site map: [/de/llms.txt](https://demodesk.ai/de/llms.txt)

## Connectors

- [Connect Any Tool](https://demodesk.ai/connectors) — Demodesk connectors let AI agents work with any tool that has public API documentation, beyond native integrations.
- [Jedes Tool verbinden](https://demodesk.ai/de/connectors) — Mit Demodesk Konnektoren arbeiten KI-Agenten mit jedem Tool, das eine öffentliche API-Dokumentation hat.

## Integrations

- [Integrations](https://demodesk.ai/integrations) — Connect Demodesk to your CRM, calendar, video, dialer, and sales engagement tools for automatic call capture, coaching, and CRM updates. Dialers include Aircall, RingCentral, CloudCall, Zoom Phone, Microsoft Teams Phone, Outreach, Kixie, Dialpad, JustCall, CloudTalk, Ringover, Ring.io, Salesforce Sales Dialer, HubSpot Calling, 8x8, Quo (OpenPhone), Nextiva, Vonage, and Talkdesk. Also covers Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Microsoft Outlook, Google Workspace, Microsoft Teams, Google Meet, Zoom, Salesloft, Make, and the Demodesk API. Messaging covers Slack and Microsoft Teams notifications.
- For tools without a native integration, see [Connect Any Tool](https://demodesk.ai/connectors) — Demodesk's connector framework for any tool with public API documentation.

## Apps & Downloads

- MCP server & ChatGPT app: Query recordings, transcripts, summaries, and scorecards in ChatGPT, Claude, and any MCP client. Server URL https://demodesk.com/mcp — details at https://mcp.demodesk.ai/.

## Key Differentiators

- Instant post-call coaching — seconds after call ends, not 20-30 minutes
- 99% CRM accuracy — zero manual data entry

- 98 languages supported
- Custom AI agents via AI Agent Builder + 158+ marketplace skills
